text: When a partner dies, the executor of the deceased partner's estate is required to settle the deceased partner's share of the profits or losses of the firm up to the date of death. What is the formula to calculate the amount of interest to be added to the deceased partner's share?
explanation: The amount of interest to be added to the deceased partner's share is calculated using the formula: Interest = $ rac{P \times R \times T}{100}$, where P is the amount of the deceased partner's share, R is the rate of interest, and T is the time period.
